john-p-escalera.text: In March 2026, Escalera voted yes (4-0) to buy an all-electric backhoe loader using California Clean Off-Road Equipment (CORE) voucher funding, amending the 2026 budget by $65,000.

source.title: La Puente Valley County Water District minutes, board meeting March 9, 2026
